full_page.content:
Page 68 Cont.
May 18 Mrs. Lena Mac Leod - 63 - Episcopelian. Hopelessly cancerous. En- rolled in Ser. Mass To-night by daughter
18 Mrs. Cecilia Gordon - 28 - mother of 2 or 3. .. has also husband - peculiar pains like apendicitis.
Victoria Shimanski - 47 - malaria T.B .... Very peculiar - Mrs. Annie Hofer - 64 - diabetis ... Mother of large family ..
19 Baby John Joseph Obrest - 2 mo. - born with very defective ear - en- tirely closed and small.
Joseph Colwell - 46 - one time a now nothing .... drinking and neglect- ing his wife and baby.
Page 69
May 22 Faith Lee - 14 - non Cath. - injured at birth - sadly crippled and quite hopeless as far as science .... Enrolled.
Robert P. Maroon - 3 - unable to stand alone - Infantile paralysis since five months old.
23 Thanks - Frank Gladish - 64 - Methodist - fearful case of gall stones and liver - complains - in January '42 enrolled in Ser. Masses - here To-day in perfect health ..... Deo Gr.
25 Maris Patricia Grube - 21 yesterday T.B.
Geo Burns - 30 - thinking of divorcing wife and little boy ... neg- lecting church and sacraments ... .
Jos' Cortis - 22 - Sancta Barbara Pvt. in Air Corps - NervousBrk.
James Binghan - 16 - Sinus
Mrs. Healy - ear trouble and something like cancer on face.
Page 70 May 26 26 Baby Patricia Forster - 14 mo. - inceflitis ..... since last Friday Drs have very little hopes ... inscribed in perpetual S.M.A.
Mrs. M. Hoffman - 88 - quite sick
